title: sites.brief-render-plan.candidate.v0.1
description: Proposed private technical plan joining one exact source snapshot, separately selected six-field editorial input and expected artifact bytes. It is not a renderer execution receipt, source authentication, editorial approval or publication permission.
$comment: The consumer is fixed to the existing LocalSiteRendering::render parser/renderer. renderInput must contain exactly its six fields and productCode onepage. The candidate consumer must verify tenant/site/snapshot identity, snapshot manifestSha256 over the original file bytes, every payload size/hash, the complete source profile and expected artifact size/hash. It must not re-encode JSON for digest checks, infer copy from the rich source, substitute a newer snapshot, or invoke a provider selected by the plan. These relationships, authorization, duplicate-key rejection and idempotency are not established by JSON Schema validation.

reference.description: Opaque selector, never a URL, path, credential or authority.

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of exact original bytes, not normalized or re-encoded JSON.
